limitations.note: The patch fixed the combinational feedback in the shift register but made reset synchronous and drove `data` from the newly rotated state instead of registering the pre-rotation bit, shifting the output sequence by one clock.

limitations.quote: Reset should take effect on the rising edge
limitations.note: The test required synchronous reset and counted the reset-held zero as the first pattern bit before the first post-reset rising edge, so it validated the patch's timing assumptions rather than catching either mismatch.
